versions.content: Event groups provided by a ProvidedServiceInstance If the ProvidedServiceInstance publishes an event group then the PduActiva- tionRoutingGroup that is aggregated in the role pduActivationRoutingGroup by an EventHandler is activated. The interested clients can subscribe to the pub- lished event groups until the offer is stopped.
